bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Write-back cache for /home exceeded safe thresholds after an unexpected application shutdown. Dirty pages: 12,384 (~56 MB) on ext4 (/dev/sda1). To prevent data loss, flush and re-sync the filesystem. You may continue working, but performance could briefly degrade during the operation.
